text:
Sam (recruiter): heads up — offer out for Lila (senior infra eng), wants 6/1 start but needs to relocate from EMEA. Manager asked for a small sign-on + earlier benefits eligibility. Can we route an exception?
Priya (people-ops): ok — can you summarize requested exceptions and rationale? include compband ask and benefit start date.
Sam (recruiter): ask = sign-on $8k one-time, compband is within band but manager requests provisional uplift to midpoint+5% pending budget; benefits start on day 1 instead of standard first-of-month. candidate is willing to start earlier if benefits are available day 1.
Elaine (comp): provisional uplift to midpoint+5% is a comp exception. need manager justification + budget owner approval. also confirm total OTE impact and comp band code.
Sam (recruiter): manager note: Lila has competing offer, critical infra hire, 6 months to full ramp, revenue impact high. budget owner = Marcus (infra lead). OTE impact ~ $9k recurring annualized.
Mike (finance): finance okay to review but need GL code and headcount confirmation. provisional uplift affects run-rate, sign-on is one-time. we can approve sign-on from hiring budget if leader OK. please attach proposed offer breakdown.
Sam (recruiter): attaching breakdown in thread (snippet):
```
Base: 160000
Sign-on: 8000 (one-time)
Provisional uplift: +5% base (~8k annual)
Total comp (first year est): 176000
```
Priya (people-ops): routing plan I propose: Manager -> People Ops (Elaine) -> Finance (Mike) -> Compensation Committee (if uplift above policy) -> Legal (for any terms) -> People Ops final. sign-on/day1 benefits can be approved at People Ops + Finance if within guidelines.
Anna (legal): quick Q: will day-1 benefits require any contract language change for prorated premiums or backdated coverage? if yes we need to add sentence to offer.
Chandra (onboarding): operational note — if benefits start day 1, benefits team needs 72h lead time for enrollment feed. for remote/intl relocation we need address verification + benefits eligibility check. can we set effective date to start_date and run enrollment on day 0?
Sam (recruiter): candidate target start 2026-06-01. we can accept a short window for verification if benefits effective 6/1.
Mike (finance): GL code = 5012 (engineering payroll). headcount confirmed. finance provisional ok for sign-on and day-1 benefits if hiring leader signs off and total run-rate impact approved by Marcus. uplift <=5% might be approvable without committee — Elaine confirm?
Elaine (comp): per policy, uplift up to 3% is auto, 3-7% needs comp review sign-off + finance. so 5% needs comp review (that is me) and leader approval, no committee unless >7%. I'll review and sign if manager memo included. please upload manager justification doc.
Sam (recruiter): uploading manager memo now — short bullets on comp risk, competitor offer, and business impact.
Priya (people-ops): decision checklist for us: 1) manager justification uploaded 2) finance GL + headcount ok (Mike) 3) comp review sign-off (Elaine) 4) legal to confirm offer language for day-1 benefits (Anna) 5) onboarding readiness (Chandra). if all green, People Ops will approve sign-on + day-1 benefits and apply provisional uplift for offer letter.
Anna (legal): sample clause we can add: "Benefits eligibility and enrollment will commence on the employee's start date; premiums and retroactive coverage are subject to carrier rules. Enrollment is contingent on timely submission of verification documents." we can include that in the offer.
Chandra (onboarding): I'll queue benefits team and request expedited feed. we'll need candidate passport or visa docs for relocation and new address by 5/25 to meet 6/1 effective.
Sam (recruiter): noted — I'll ask candidate for address + docs and confirm timeline.
OnboardBot: Reminder: benefits enrollment cutoff 72h before effective date — escalate to benefits-team if verification incomplete by 2026-05-29.
Priya (people-ops): next steps: Sam to gather docs + attach manager memo; Elaine to record comp sign-off; Mike to mark finance approval; Anna to update offer template; Chandra to confirm feed. target approvals by 2026-05-28 to hit 6/1.
Sam (recruiter): will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Elaine (comp): leaving a note: comp sign-off pending review of manager memo. if anything changes I'll post here.
Mike (finance): noted, putting provisional approval in our tracker.
Anna (legal): I'll create updated offer template and post link here when done.
Chandra (onboarding): prepping checklist, will ping benefits-team now.
Sam (recruiter): bump — manager memo uploaded. tagging @Priya.
Priya (people-ops): got it, starting review now. will update thread with final approval or questions by EOD 2026-05-26.
Sam (recruiter): thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
